features.claim: Argentinosaurus was an enormous, long-necked, long-tailed, four-legged plant-eater.
features.quote: It was an enormous, long-necked, long-tailed, quadrupedal, plant-eater from Argentina, South America during the Cretaceous period.

features.claim: It was a giant sauropod dinosaur.
features.quote: Argentinosaurus (meaning "lizard from Argentina") is a genus of giant sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period in what is now Argentina.

features.claim: It measured 30–35 m long and weighed 65–80 tonnes.
features.quote: Although it is only known from fragmentary remains, Argentinosaurus was one of the largest known land animals of all time, measuring 30–35 m (98–115 ft) long and weighing 65–80 t (72–88 short tons).

How it moved:
on four legs
